tasks.description: 1.1 Continue the six pinned retained font boundaries through original code to the natural texture entry with fresh offscreen GDI; add owned-handle guards, cleanup/source tests and documentation; verify reports preserve the original frames, IAT and derived state.

2.1 Independently replay all six source/write traces and full memory/CPU, check pixels/geometry, and exercise all 21 catalogued names through actual offscreen GDI; add corruption/ownership tests and document encoding limits; verify targeted and adjacent regressions.

3.1 Run strict OpenSpec and full preservation checks, update the master R3 evidence without claiming completion, commit locally and archive this completed change with exact hashes; verify all tasks, archive mapping and Git bytes match acceptance evidence.

context:
本项目为 Cross Hermit 原版逆向与 Godot 重制工作区，两者的完成状态分开报告。
逆向总范围、完成标准、2026-11-20目标及待完成里程碑以
openspec/specs/reverse-engineering/completion/spec.md 为准。
add-fifth-week-school-planning 已于2026-10-20归档，是历史记录，不再追加任务。
其423–428未完成计划已迁入总规格R1–R6，不得当作已完成研究。
每次继续推进先接续对应的有效change；没有对应change时才为下一个有限功能里程碑创建change。
不为每次对话、每条消息或每个接口新建change，不将所有余下工作堆入一个持续扩张的change。
完成的规格同步到总spec后归档对应change；历史原始证据、原存档及私有检查点保持不变。
完成连贯工作单元后本地Git提交，不push。
